name: go-jwt-api
title: Go token service
default_description: A JSON API with accounts and bearer tokens.
blurb: A JSON API with real accounts: PBKDF2 password digests, HMAC-signed bearer tokens, and a token check that behaves the same whether the token expired or was forged.

verify.name: selftest
verify.cmd: mkdir -p build && go build -o build/{{ npm_name }} . && ./build/{{ npm_name }} --selftest

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
set -e
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5455/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "port 5455 is already answering - stop that process before running this step" >&2
  exit 1
fi
work=$(mktemp -d)
log=$(mktemp)
server=""
trap 'kill -TERM $server 2>/dev/null || true; wait $server 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$work" "$log"' EXIT
make -s build
TOKEN_SECRET=step-secret PORT=5455 ./build/{{ npm_name }} --db "$work/users.json" >"$log" 2>&1 &
server=$!
ready=0
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5455/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
  sleep 0.25
done
if [ "$ready" != 1 ]; then cat "$log" >&2; exit 1; fi
kill -0 "$server"
body=$work/body.json
fail=0
check() {
  if [ "$2" = "$3" ]; then echo "ok $1"; else echo "FAIL $1: want [$3] got [$2]"; fail=1; fi
}
has() { if grep -Fq -- "$2" "$body"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; }
status() { curl -sS -o "$body" -w '%{http_code}' "$@"; }
base=http://127.0.0.1:5455
check health "$(status "$base/health")" 200
check health_users "$(has users '"users":0')" yes
check register "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"ada@example.com","password":"correct horse"}' "$base/register")" 201
check registered_email "$(has email '"email":"ada@example.com"')" yes
check duplicate "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"ADA@example.com","password":"correct horse"}' "$base/register")" 409
check duplicate_error "$(has email_taken '"error":"email_taken"')" yes
check weak "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"new@example.com","password":"short"}' "$base/register")" 422
check missing_password "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"new@example.com"}' "$base/register")" 422
check bad_json "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":' "$base/register")" 422
check login "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"ada@example.com","password":"correct horse"}' "$base/login")" 200
token=$(sed -n 's/.*"token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$body")
if [ -n "$token" ]; then echo "ok login_token"; else echo "FAIL login_token: empty"; fail=1; fi
check wrong_password "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"ada@example.com","password":"nope nope"}' "$base/login")" 401
check unknown_email "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"ghost@example.com","password":"nope nope"}' "$base/login")" 401
check me "$(status -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" "$base/me")" 200
check me_email "$(has ada@example.com ada@example.com)" yes
check me_missing "$(status "$base/me")" 401
check me_scheme "$(status -H 'Authorization: Basic abc' "$base/me")" 401
check me_forged "$(status -H "Authorization: Bearer ${token}x" "$base/me")" 401
check me_forged_error "$(has invalid_token '"error":"invalid_token"')" yes
check not_found "$(status "$base/nope")" 404
check not_found_detail "$(has 'no route for GET /nope' 'no route for GET /nope')" yes
check wrong_method "$(status -X POST "$base/health")" 405
check persisted "$(grep -c 'pbkdf2-sha256' "$work/users.json")" 1
if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then echo "http contract failed" >&2; exit 1; fi
curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5455/health >/dev/null
